Consider the following PR description:
New Line Character Detection Issue in YAML Files

Description

I've encountered an issue with the new line character detection at the end of YAML files. It seems that the check for a new line character at the end of the file is not functioning as expected. When processing YAML files, the system does not correctly identify the absence of a new line character at the end of the file, leading to unexpected behavior.

Environment:
- Operating System: Linux
- Python Version: 3.10.15
- Affected Module: yamllint

Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a YAML file without a new line character at the end.
2. Run the linting process on this file.
3. Observe that the system does not flag the missing new line character as an issue.

Expected Behavior:
The system should detect and report the absence of a new line character at the end of the file.

Actual Behavior:
The system does not report any issues, even when the new line character is missing at the end of the file.

This issue affects the reliability of the linting process, as it fails to enforce the expected file formatting rules.
</pr_description>
